notes.prepItem: [KIRIE'S BAG] While held, alters the action of Forgetting a Spell to lose net 0-1 REASON, gain 1% DOOM, and gain a new random spell.
other: The SELF-THERAPY perk increases REASON gained by forgetting spells, shifting BAG usage to gaining 0-1 REASON rather than losing any.
The spell BRAIN WORMS does not trigger KIRIE'S BAG, serving as a dead end when cycling through random spells.

notes.startBonus: Has an innate +10% bonus to Offensive combat action speed.
notes.prepItem: [AIKO'S PLUSH TOY] While equipped, Perception and Luck stats temporarily receive -2, and you receive -1 incoming damage.
other: Can gain an additional +15% bonus to Offensive action speed with the FAST SWIMMER perk.

notes.startBonus: Begins with CIGARETTES, and the mental curse NICOTINE WITHDRAWAL.
notes.uniqueStatus: Gains +1 to outgoing damage while under the NICOTINE RUSH effect.
notes.prepItem: [CIGARETTE CASE] While held, every investigated location has a 15% chance to add 1 cigarette to the cigarette counter.

notes.uniqueStatus: Requires at least 2 allies present at the end of each mystery, otherwise -2 REASON.
notes.prepItem: [VANITY MIRROR] While equipped or held, event choice skill checks are revealed.
[FILM ROLL] Reusable item that can exchange -1 FUNDS for +10 EXPERIENCE.

notes.uniqueStatus: -20% MAX REASON applied to what the full amount should be, impacting upgrades as well as starting total.
notes.prepItem: [ANATOMY BOOK] Reusable item that can exchange -2 STAMINA for +8 EXPERIENCE, even if the STAMINA loss will kill you.

notes.uniqueStatus: Permanently gains +1 to all stats for every 20% of DOOM reached for the first time.
notes.prepItem: [GUITAR] While held, RESTING at home grants an additional +1 REASON and +1% DOOM.
[BLESSED SHELL] Single use while in combat grants +1 AMMO, +5% DOOM, and +10 damage with the SHOOT action until the end of the current combat.

notes.uniqueStatus: Ominous Letter status raises the EXPERIENCE requirement to 120, and offers action to exchange -4 REASON for +3 FAITH, or -2 STAMINA for -3 FAITH.
notes.prepItem: [MARKED BIBLE] While held, RESTING at home will grant an extra +1 REASON if FAITH is at or above 1, or +1 STAMINA if FAITH is at or below 0.
other: The unique FAITH stat increases by defeating enemies and solving mysteries, and is lowered equal to damage received in combat.
Higher FAITH grants additional EXP, MAX STAMINA, and MAX REASON from mystery completion, while negative FAITH values will cause a loss of each instead.

notes.startBonus: Begins with the ONYX MEDALLION, which cannot be removed.
notes.uniqueStatus: Inflicted with +2 CURSES each mystery, but can use the MEDALLION to cure 1 CURSE per mystery.
notes.prepItem: [AYAKA'S CHALK] While equipped, grants +2 damage against GHOSTS.
[BOOK STRAP] While equipped, grants +10% combat action speed for each Book held in your inventory.

notes.uniqueStatus: Leveling up costs 50 less EXPERIENCE, but you are pursued by HORROR in an ACTIVE RITUAL.
notes.prepItem: [CHECK BOOK] Reusable item that exchanges +3% DOOM for +5 FUNDS.
other: The HORROR meter increases at twice the rate of your DOOM increases, and is not lowered by DOOM reduction.
When HORROR catches up at 100%, EXPERIENCE is locked preventing you from gaining more levels.
HORROR is lowered by 10% for completing a mystery.
Obtaining the PREPARE item and using it once results in 16% HORROR progression.

notes.startBonus: Begins with the LUCKY BAT, and the minor injury CONCUSSION.
notes.prepItem: [BASEBALL] Used in combat, the enemy's POWER is reduced to 0.

other: Futher details of TAROT DECK etc, pending.

notes.uniqueStatus: Receives -1 damage from EVENT outcomes, down to a minimum of 1.
notes.prepItem: No custom item: Randomly obtains either a [BANDAGE], [ENERGY DRINK], or [WOODEN BAT].

notes.uniqueStatus: Details of unique perk MEAT PUPPET pending.
MAX STAMINA and MAX REASON are capped at 8. When either stat reaches 0, instead of dying the stat is reset to 8 and you gain +5% DOOM.
notes.prepItem: No custom item: Randomly obtains either a [BANDAGE], [ENERGY DRINK], or [WOODEN BAT].
other: The first time STAMINA or REASON reaches 0, gain an additional unique status which tracks the number of death's cheated.
